description: This file defines the ConflictDelta class which handles conflict resolution strategies during data synchronization, including conflict detection, strategy determination, and payload handling.

classes.name: ConflictDelta
classes.description: A class responsible for managing conflict resolution during synchronization, including strategy determination and payload handling.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Generates the final delta emit after conflict resolution based on the applied payload and conflict strategy.

methods.name: getConflictStrategy
methods.description: Determines the conflict resolution strategy based on payload states and existing conflicts.

methods.name: handleStrategy
methods.description: Dispatches to specific payload handling methods based on the chosen conflict strategy.

methods.name: handleKeepBaseStrategy
methods.description: Handles conflict resolution by keeping the base payload.

methods.name: handleKeepApplyStrategy
methods.description: Handles conflict resolution by applying the incoming payload.

methods.name: handleKeepBaseDuplicateApply
methods.description: Handles conflict resolution by duplicating the apply payload and keeping the base.

methods.name: handleDuplicateBaseKeepApply
methods.description: Handles conflict resolution by duplicating the base payload and applying the incoming payload.

methods.name: handleKeepBaseMergeRefsStrategy
methods.description: Merges references in the base payload during conflict resolution.
